narrative.intro: TriWest Healthcare Alliance obligated $900M in FY2027 to date. TriWest Healthcare Alliance received 3 awards so far in the fiscal year, producing an average award size of $300M. TriWest Healthcare Alliance obligations fell 94.6% year over year. TriWest Healthcare Alliance obligations in FY2027 to date are concentrated in one NAICS market: Direct Health and Medical Insurance Carriers, which accounts for $900M. TriWest Healthcare Alliance recorded $0 in the Pharmacy Benefit Management and Other Third Party Administration of Insurance and Pension Funds market in FY2027 to date. Historical context shows TriWest Healthcare Alliance obligations were higher in prior years, with recorded totals of $7.4B in FY22, $8B in FY23, $8.4B in FY24, $13.4B in FY25, and $16.6B in FY26. The current-year totals are partial and represent fiscal year to date activity, not full-year totals. The data presented are contract obligations except where tables list total contract values for largest awards and expiring contracts.
